phrases.english: What time is it, please?
phrases.transliteration: daya kari, bartamana kete bela?

phrases.english: I’m running late, sorry.
phrases.transliteration: mu deiri heuchhi, dukkhit

phrases.english: It’s a quarter past eight.
phrases.transliteration: eta ahta panchera minit pare

phrases.english: It’s almost ten o’clock.
phrases.transliteration: dasata hebaku jauchhi

phrases.english: We’ll meet at seven sharp.
phrases.transliteration: ame satata kahidele misibu

phrases.english: Where is the checkout counter, please?
phrases.transliteration: dayākarī kāuṇṭar keunṭhi?

phrases.english: How much is this, exactly?
phrases.transliteration: ehāra dām kete, ṭhik achhi?

phrases.english: Can I try this on, please?
phrases.transliteration: dayākarī, ehā piṇḍhi dekhibārībi?

phrases.english: I only want one piece.
phrases.transliteration: mote kebala goṭiē pīs darakār.

phrases.english: Do you have it in small size?
phrases.transliteration: choṭa sāij-re achhi ki?

phrases.english: It’s sunny today, enjoy the day.
phrases.odia: ଆଜି ସୂର୍ଯ୍ୟକିରଣ ଅଛି, ଦିନଟା ଉପଭୋଗ କରନ୍ତୁ।
phrases.transliteration: Aji surjya-kiran achhi, dinata upabhoga karantu.

phrases.english: Clouds are gathering, it might rain.
phrases.transliteration: Megha jamuchhi, barsha hoipare.

phrases.english: The rain is light, don’t worry.
phrases.transliteration: Haluka barsha heuchhi, chinta karantu-ni.

phrases.english: It’s raining now, take an umbrella.
phrases.transliteration: Ebe barsha heuchhi, chhata niaantu.

phrases.english: The wind is strong today, be careful.
phrases.odia: ଆଜି ପବନ ବେଶ ଜୋର, ସାବଧାନ ରୁହନ୍ତୁ।
phrases.transliteration: Aji paban besh jor, sabadhaana ruhantu.

phrases.english: I practice daily, slowly, and keep going.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ପ୍ରତିଦିନ ଅଭ୍ୟାସ କରେ, ଧୀରେ ଧୀରେ, ଆଉ ଚାଲୁ ରଖେ।
phrases.transliteration: Muṁ pratidina abhyaasa kare, dhire dhire, aau chalu rakhe.

phrases.english: Today, I will try again, no worries.
phrases.odia: ଆଜି, ମୁଁ ପୁନି ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରିବି, ଚିନ୍ତା ନାହିଁ।
phrases.transliteration: Aji, muṁ puni chesta karibi, chinta nahin.

phrases.english: I’m improving, one small step at a time.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ଉନ୍ନତି କରୁଛି, ପ୍ରତିଥର ଗୋଟିଏ ଛୋଟ ପଦକ୍ଷେପରେ।
phrases.transliteration: Muṁ unnati karuchhi, pratyekathara gotie chhota padakhepare.

phrases.english: Keep breathing, and speak with confidence.
phrases.transliteration: Shwas ni‘a, aau atmabishwase kah.

phrases.english: Mistakes help me learn, so relax.
phrases.odia: ଭୁଲମାନେ ମୋତେ ଶିଖାଏ, ତେଣୁ ଆରାମ କର।
phrases.transliteration: Bhulumane mote shikha‘e, tena au aaram kar.

phrases.english: A cow is eating grass, slowly.
phrases.transliteration: Gai dheire dheire ghas khaauchhi.

phrases.english: The cat wants to come inside, please.
phrases.transliteration: Bileiti bhitaraku asibaku chahun̐chhi, dayakari.

phrases.english: Look at the dog, it’s wagging.
phrases.transliteration: Kukuraku dekh, eha laja jhulaauchhi.

phrases.english: That bird is singing outside, loudly.
phrases.transliteration: Sehi pakshīti baahare jore gaauchhi.

phrases.english: The frog is jumping near the pond.
phrases.transliteration: Pokharī paakhare ben̐gata lṃphuchhi.

phrases.english: I love this song, it’s so catchy.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ଏହି ଗୀତଟାକୁ ଭଲପାଏ, ବହୁତ ଆକର୍ଷକ।
phrases.transliteration: Mu ehi geetataaku bhala paaye, bahuta aakarshaka.

phrases.english: Play it again, please.
phrases.transliteration: Daya kari ehaku puni chalaantu.

phrases.english: That rhythm feels amazing.
phrases.transliteration: Sehi rhythm-ta adbhuta laaguchi.

phrases.english: Turn the volume up a little.
phrases.transliteration: Tike volyum baḍhaantu.

phrases.english: Turn it down, it’s too loud.
phrases.transliteration: Kam karantu, ehā bahuta jor.

phrases.english: I need a smaller EMI this month.
phrases.odia: ମୋ ଏହି ମାସରେ ଛୋଟ EMI ଦରକାର।
phrases.transliteration: Mo ei masare chhota EMI darkar.

phrases.english: Please check my bank balance now.
phrases.odia: ଦୟାକରି ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ ମୋ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ବ୍ୟାଲାନ୍ସ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କର।
phrases.transliteration: Dayakari bartaman mo bank balance janch kar.

phrases.english: Did my salary get credited today, please?
phrases.odia: ଆଜି ମୋ ଦରମା ଆସିଛି କି, ଦୟାକରି?
phrases.transliteration: Aji mo dhrama asichi ki, dayakari?

phrases.english: I want to open a savings account.
phrases.transliteration: Mu sevinges akount kholibaku chahunchi.

phrases.english: The ATM declined my card again.
phrases.odia: ଏହି ATM ଆଉଥରେ ମୋ କାର୍ଡ ଅସ୍ଵୀକାର କରିଲା।
phrases.transliteration: Ei ATM autehare mo card aswikar karila.

phrases.english: I love you, my heart.
phrases.transliteration: Muṁ tumaku bhalapae, mo hr̥daya.

phrases.english: You make me feel safe, always.
phrases.transliteration: Tume mote sabubele surakhita lage.

phrases.english: I miss you, please come back.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ତୁମକୁ ମିସ୍ କରୁଛି, ଦୟାକରି ଫେରିଆସ।
phrases.transliteration: Muṁ tumaku mis karuchi, dayakari feriās.

phrases.english: Stay with me, just tonight.
phrases.transliteration: Āji rātire, mo sahita ruh.

phrases.english: Your smile is my favorite thing.
phrases.transliteration: Tum hasa mora sarbaśreṣṭha.

phrases.english: Thank you for your kindness, really.
phrases.transliteration: Apananka bhalaman paain dhanyabad.

phrases.english: I truly appreciate your help today.
phrases.odia: ଆଜି ଆପଣଙ୍କ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ପାଇଁ ମୁଁ ଖୁବ ଆଭାରୀ।
phrases.transliteration: Aji apananka sahajya paain mu sebu aabari.

phrases.english: Thanks, you made my day better.
phrases.odia: ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ, ଆପଣ ମୋ ଦିନଟା ଭଲ କରିଦେଲେ।
phrases.transliteration: Dhanyabad, apana mo dinata bhala karidele.

phrases.english: I’m grateful for everything you do.
phrases.odia: ଆପଣ କରୁଥିବା ସବୁକିଛି ପାଇଁ ମୁଁ ଆଭାରୀ।
phrases.transliteration: Apana karuthiba sabukichhi paain mu aabari.

phrases.english: Thank you for listening to me.
phrases.transliteration: Mo katha sunibaa paain dhanyabad.

phrases.english: I will improve, day by day,
phrases.transliteration: Mu̐ pratidina aagaku baḍḥibī,

phrases.english: Stay calm, even when things change,
phrases.transliteration: Bipada hele madhya shaanta ruhantu,

phrases.english: I can learn from every mistake,
phrases.transliteration: Mu̐ pr̥t̥iṭi bhul̥aru śikḥipāribi,

phrases.english: Small steps, big progress, you know,
phrases.transliteration: Chhoṭa padakṣepa, baḍa unnatī, jāṇantu,

phrases.english: Today, I choose to do my best,
phrases.transliteration: Āji, mu̐ mora sarbaśreṣṭha karibī,

phrases.english: I can face this, step by step.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ଏହାକୁ ସାମ୍ନା କରିପାରିବି, ପଦେ ପଦେ।
phrases.transliteration: Mu eha ku saamna karipaaribi, pade pade.

phrases.english: Take a deep breath, you’ve got this.
phrases.transliteration: Gabheera shwaasa niau, tume paariba.

phrases.english: Don’t be afraid, speak up now.
phrases.transliteration: Bhaya karanaahin, ebe kahidi a.

phrases.english: I’ll try again, even if it’s hard.
phrases.odia: କଠିନ ହେଲେମଧ୍ୟ, ମୁଁ ପୁଣି ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରିବି।
phrases.transliteration: Kathiina helamadhya, mu puni chesta karibi.

phrases.english: Be brave, small steps still count.
phrases.odia: ସାହସ କର, ଛୋଟ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ମଧ୍ୟ ଗଣିଯାଏ।
phrases.transliteration: Sahasa kara, chhota padakhepa madhya gani jaae.

phrases.english: I breathe in, and I feel calm.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନେଉଛି, ଆଉ ମୁଁ ଶାନ୍ତ ଲାଗୁଛି।
phrases.transliteration: Mũ shwasa neuchi, aau mũ shaanta laguchhi.

phrases.english: In silence, my heart settles down.
phrases.transliteration: Neirabatare, mo hriday shaanta hue.

phrases.english: Let go now, everything is okay.
phrases.odia: ଏବେ ଛାଡ଼ି ଦେଅ, ସବୁ ଠିକ ଅଛି।
phrases.transliteration: Ebe chhadi deau, sabu thik achhi.

phrases.english: I choose peace, not worry.
phrases.transliteration: Mũ chinta nuhẽ, shaanti baachhuchhi.

phrases.english: My mind feels lighter, one moment.
phrases.odia: ମୋ ମନ ହାଲୁକା ଲାଗୁଛି, ଏକ ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତ।
phrases.transliteration: Mo mana haluka laguchhi, eka muhurtta.

phrases.english: I study Odia every morning, slowly.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ପ୍ରତିଦିନ ସକାଳେ ଓଡ଼ିଆ ପଢ଼ୁଛି, ଧୀରେ।
phrases.transliteration: Mū pratidina sakālE oḍia paḍhuchi, dheire.

phrases.english: Can you explain this lesson, please?
phrases.transliteration: Dayakari ehi pāṭaṭi bujhāi pāribe ki?

phrases.english: I don’t understand this word, yet.
phrases.transliteration: Ehi shabdaṭa mū ejābat bujhi pāruni.

phrases.english: Please speak a little more slowly.
phrases.transliteration: Dayakari ṭike āu dheire kahan̄tu.

phrases.english: What does this sentence mean, in Odia?
phrases.transliteration: Odiare ehi bākyara arṭha kaṇ̣a?

phrases.english: What festivals are you celebrating this month?
phrases.transliteration: Ei maasare keun utsab palauchha?

phrases.english: Today, we all meet at the temple.
phrases.transliteration: Aji, ame samaste mandirare miluchhu.

phrases.english: People here share food with neighbors.
phrases.odia: ଏଠାର ଲୋକମାନେ ପଡ଼ୋଶୀଙ୍କ ସହ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ବାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତି।
phrases.transliteration: Ethaara lokamanen padośiṅka saha khaadya baṇṭanti.

phrases.english: Do you drink tea after morning prayers?
phrases.odia: ସକାଳ ପୂଜା ପରେ ଆପଣ ଚାହା ପିଅନ୍ତି କି?
phrases.transliteration: Sakaal pooja pare apana chaaha pibhanti ki?

phrases.english: We greet elders with folded hands.
phrases.odia: ଆମେ ବୟସ୍କମାନଙ୍କୁ ହାତ ଯୋଡ଼ି ଶୁଭେଚ୍ଛା ଦେଉ।
phrases.transliteration: Ame bayaskamananku haata joḍi shubhechchha deu.

phrases.english: Hello, how are you today?
phrases.transliteration: Namaskar, apan kemiti achhanti aji?

phrases.english: Hi there, good to see you!
phrases.transliteration: Namaskar, apankku dekhi bhala lagila!

phrases.english: Good morning, have a nice day!
phrases.odia: ଶୁଭ ସକାଳ, ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଦିନ ଭଲ ହେଉ!
phrases.transliteration: Shubha sakala, apankara dina bhala heau!

phrases.english: Good afternoon, hope you’re doing well.
phrases.odia: ଶୁଭ ଦୁପୁର, ଆପଣ ଭଲ ଥାନ୍ତୁ ବୋଲି ଆଶା କରୁଛି।
phrases.transliteration: Shubha dupura, apan bhala thantu boli asha karuchhi.

phrases.english: Good evening, how’s your day going?
phrases.odia: ଶୁଭ ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟା, ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଦିନ କେମିତି ଚାଲୁଛି?
phrases.transliteration: Shubha sandhya, apankara dina kemiti chaluchhi?

phrases.english: I can do this, step by step.
phrases.transliteration: Mu eha kariparibi, dheire dheire.

phrases.english: Stay strong, you’re not alone here.
phrases.odia: ଦୃଢ଼ ରୁହ, ତୁମେ ଏଠାରେ ଏକା ନୁହଁ।
phrases.transliteration: Drudha rōha, tume ehāre eka nuha.

phrases.english: Breathe, then try again.
phrases.odia: ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଅ, ତାପରେ ଆଉଥରେ ଚେଷ୍ଟା କର।
phrases.transliteration: Shwāsa nīa, tāpare āuthare chesta kara.

phrases.english: I’ve got this, don’t worry.
phrases.transliteration: Mōr eha achhi, chinta karanā.

phrases.english: Keep going, even when it’s hard.
phrases.transliteration: Chāli chāli, jadiō eha kathiṇa.

phrases.english: My purpose is to help others, always.
phrases.odia: ମୋ ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ସଦା ଅନ୍ୟମାନଙ୍କୁ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରିବା।
phrases.transliteration: Mo uddeshya sada anyamananku sahajya kariba.

phrases.english: I want to learn Odia, every day.
phrases.transliteration: Mu pratidina odiya sikhibaku chahen.

phrases.english: My purpose today is simple, just work.
phrases.odia: ଆଜି ମୋ ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ସରଳ, କେବଳ କାମ।
phrases.transliteration: Aji mo uddeshya sarala, kebala kaam.

phrases.english: I’m here to try, not to quit.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ଛାଡ଼ିଦେବା ପାଇଁ ନୁହେଁ, ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରିବାକୁ ଆସିଛି।
phrases.transliteration: Mu chhadideba pain nuhen, chesta karibaku asichhi.

phrases.english: My purpose is peace, and kindness.
phrases.transliteration: Mo uddeshya shanti, ebam daya.

phrases.english: Inhale slowly, feel the room around you.
phrases.odia: ଧୀରେ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଅ, ତୁମ ଚାରିପଟେ ଅନୁଭବ କର।
phrases.transliteration: Dhire shwas ni’o, tuma charipate anubhaba kara.

phrases.english: Exhale gently, relax your shoulders now.
phrases.odia: ଧୀରେ ଶ୍ୱାସ ଛାଡ଼, ଏବେ ତୁମ ଦେହ ଶିଥିଲା କର।
phrases.transliteration: Dhire shwas chhād’o, ebe tuma deha shitilā kara.

phrases.english: Feel your feet, grounded and steady.
phrases.odia: ତୁମ ପାଦକୁ ଅନୁଭବ କର, ଭଲ ଭାବରେ ଦୃଢ଼।
phrases.transliteration: Tuma padaku anubhaba kara, bhala bhabare dr̥iḍha.

phrases.english: Let your breath be your guide.
phrases.odia: ତୁମ ଶ୍ୱାସକୁ ନିଜର ପଥପ୍ରଦର୍ଶକ ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅ।
phrases.transliteration: Tuma shwasaku nijara pathapradarshaka hebāku di’o.

phrases.english: Right now, be present with me.
phrases.odia: ଏଇ ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତରେ, ମୋ ସହିତ ଉପସ୍ଥିତ ରୁହ।
phrases.transliteration: Ei muhurtta re, mo sahita upasthita ruh.

phrases.english: I drink warm water every morning, slowly.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ପ୍ରତି ସକାଳେ ଧୀରେ ଧୀରେ ଗୁନା ପାଣି ପିଉଛି।
phrases.transliteration: Mu prti sakale dhire dhire guna pani pijuchi.

phrases.english: Please wash your hands before eating, now.
phrases.odia: ଦୟାକରି ଖାଇବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ହାତ ଧୁଅ, ଏବେ।
phrases.transliteration: Dayakari khaiaba purbaru hata dhu, ebe.

phrases.english: Do you have any headache today?
phrases.odia: ଆଜି ତୁମର କିଛି ମୁଣ୍ଡବିଥା ଅଛି କି?
phrases.transliteration: Aji tumara kichhi mundabitha achhi ki?

phrases.english: I feel better after rest, thank you.
phrases.odia: ବିଶ୍ରାମ ପରେ ମୋତେ ଭଲ ଲାଗୁଛି, ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ।
phrases.transliteration: Bishram pare mote bhal laguchhi, dhanyabad.

phrases.english: Let’s walk outside for ten minutes.
phrases.transliteration: Chal, bahare dasha minit chaliba.

phrases.english: My wife makes our home happy, always.
phrases.odia: ମୋ ସ୍ତ୍ରୀ ଆମ ଘରକୁ ସଦା ଖୁସି କରେ।
phrases.transliteration: mo stri amara gharaku sada khusi kare

phrases.english: I miss my brother, we should talk.
phrases.odia: ମୋ ଭାଇକୁ ମୁଁ ଭଲେ ପାଏ, କଥା ହେବା ଦରକାର।
phrases.transliteration: mo bhai ku mu bhale pae, katha heba darkar

phrases.english: My friend always listens, thank you.
phrases.transliteration: mo bandhu sabubele shune, dhanyabad

phrases.english: Your father is kind, I can tell.
phrases.transliteration: tumara baba dayalu, mu janiparuchi

phrases.english: I love my sister, she understands me.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ମୋ ଭଉଣୀକୁ ଭଲ ପାଏ, ସେ ମୋତେ ବୁଝେ।

phrases.transliteration: Mū̃ bhalabhābe śuṇi, tāpare bhalakathā kahe

phrases.english: I keep my promises, no excuses.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ମୋ’ ପ୍ରତିଜ୍ଞା ପାଳନ କରେ, କୌଣସି ଅଜୁହାନା ନାହିଁ।
phrases.transliteration: Mū̃ mo’ pratijñā pālana kare, kouṇasi ajuhānā nāhĩ

phrases.english: I set one goal, and go.
phrases.transliteration: Mū̃ goṭiē lakṣa dhare, āgeijāe

phrases.english: I organize my day, step by step.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ମୋ ଦିନକୁ ସୁଠାରୁ କରେ, ପଦେ ପଦେ।
phrases.transliteration: Mū̃ mo dinaku suṭhāru kare, pade pade

phrases.english: Pause, breathe, and choose your next words.
phrases.odia: ଥମ, ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଅ, ଏବଂ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ କଥା ଚୟନ କର।
phrases.transliteration: Tham, shwasa niau, ebam parbartti katha chayan kara.

phrases.english: Learn slowly, but keep moving forward.
phrases.transliteration: Dhire sikha, kintu agaku chal.

phrases.english: Be grateful, even for small blessings.
phrases.odia: ଛୋଟ ଆଶୀଷ ପାଇଁ ମଧ୍ୟ କୃତଜ୍ଞ ହୁଅ।
phrases.transliteration: Chhota asisha pain madhya krutajna hu-a.

phrases.english: Truth speaks softly, but never breaks.
phrases.odia: ସତ୍ୟ ନିରବେ କହେ, କିନ୍ତୁ କେବେ ଭାଙ୍ଗେ ନାହିଁ।
phrases.transliteration: Satya nirabe kahe, kintu kebe bhange nahin.

phrases.english: Before judging, ask yourself why.
phrases.transliteration: Bichara kariba purbaru, nijaku pacha-a.

phrases.english: I trust myself, I’m capable.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ନିଜକୁ ଭରସା କରେ, ମୁଁ ସକ୍ଷମ।
phrases.transliteration: Mu nija ku bharasa kare, mu sakshama

phrases.english: I’ll try again, I won’t quit.
phrases.transliteration: Mu puni chesta karibi, chhadi-bini

phrases.english: Step by step, I’ll manage.
phrases.transliteration: Pade pade, mu sambhalibi

phrases.english: I can learn this, day by day.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ଏହା ଶିଖିପାରିବି, ଦିନ ପରେ ଦିନ।
phrases.transliteration: Mu eha shikh-i paribi, dina pare dina

phrases.english: I’ll do my best, always.
phrases.transliteration: Mu sabu bele mora sarbashreshtha karibi

phrases.english: Keep going, even when it feels hard,
phrases.transliteration: Chali jaao, jete bele taan laaguchi,

phrases.english: You’ve got this, just take one step,
phrases.odia: ତୁମେ ପାରିବ, ମାତ୍ର ଗୋଟିଏ ପାଦ ନିଅ,
phrases.transliteration: Tume paariba, maatṛa gotie paad niau,

phrases.english: Stay positive, your effort will show,
phrases.transliteration: Sakaaraatmaka rhu, tumara chesṭa dekhaajiba,

phrases.english: Don’t wait, start now, right away,
phrases.transliteration: Apekshaa karanaahin, ebe aarambha kara,

phrases.english: Small wins add up, keep moving,
phrases.odia: ଛୋଟ ସଫଳତା ଜମେଇ ହୁଏ, ଆଗକୁ ଚାଲ,
phrases.transliteration: Chhota safalata jamei hue, aagaku chala,

phrases.english: Take your time, I’ll manage here.
phrases.odia: ନିଜ ସମୟ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, ମୁଁ ଏଠାରେ ଦେଖୁଛି।
phrases.transliteration: nije samaya nihuṇtu, mũ eṭhāre dekhuchhi.

phrases.english: Slow down, we’ll get it done.
phrases.transliteration: dhīre kara, āmē heba karidēbū.

phrases.english: I’ll listen, you go at your pace.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ଶୁଣିବି, ତୁମେ ନିଜ ଗତିରେ କହ।
phrases.transliteration: mũ śuṇibi, tume nijagati re kah.

phrases.english: Not rushed, please, we’re early.
phrases.transliteration: tarajā nāhĩ, dayākari, āmē śīghra.

phrases.english: Stay with me, we’re almost there.
phrases.odia: ମୋ ସହ ରୁହ, ଆମେ ପ୍ରାୟ ସେଠାରେ।
phrases.transliteration: mo sah aruḥa, āmē prāẏa seṭhāre.

phrases.english: Happy New Year to you, friends!
phrases.transliteration: aapananku nababarṣara śubhechchha, bandhumāne!

phrases.english: Enjoy your holiday, have a great time!
phrases.transliteration: chhuṭiku upabhoga karantu, durdānta huāntu!

phrases.english: Merry Christmas, may joy follow you.
phrases.odia: ଶୁଭ କ୍ରିଷ୍ଟମାସ, ଆନନ୍ଦ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ସହ ରହୁ!
phrases.transliteration: śubha krisṭmās, ānanda aapananka saha rahu!

phrases.english: Happy Diwali! Light your home with hope.
phrases.transliteration: śubha dīpābaḷi! āśāre ghara jalāntu.

phrases.english: Wishing you a peaceful Eid today.
phrases.transliteration: āji aapananku śāntimaya īd abhinnandan.

phrases.english: Good morning, I am visiting Odisha.
phrases.odia: ଶୁଭ ସକାଳ, ମୁଁ ଓଡ଼ିଶା ଦେଖିବାକୁ ଆସିଛି।
phrases.transliteration: Shubha sakala, muṁ Oḍiśā dekhībāku āsichhi.

phrases.english: Please help me, I’m lost.
phrases.transliteration: Dayākari sāhāyya karantu, muṁ harāigali.

phrases.english: Which platform is for this train?
phrases.transliteration: Ehi ṭren̄ pāiṁ keuṅ plāṭapharm?

phrases.english: I want to go to the beach.
phrases.transliteration: Muṁ samudrakūḷaku yibāku chāhuṅchhi.

phrases.english: Is there a restroom nearby?
phrases.transliteration: Nikaṭare ṭoeleṭ achhi ki?

phrases.english: Start before you feel ready, just begin.
phrases.odia: ତୁମେ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ଲାଗିଲେ ନୁହେଁ, ଆରମ୍ଭ କର।
phrases.transliteration: tume prastuta lagile nuhe n, arambha kara

phrases.english: Small wins add up, day by day.
phrases.odia: ଛୋଟ ଜୟ ଗଣିଲେ, ପ୍ରତିଦିନ ଗୋଟେ ହୁଏ।
phrases.transliteration: chhota jaya ganile, pratidina gote hue

phrases.english: Be kind to yourself, you’re learning.
phrases.transliteration: nija ku daya kara, tume sikhu chha

phrases.english: Your effort today will help tomorrow.
phrases.transliteration: aajira prayasa asantaku madada kariba

phrases.english: Even silence can be strength, keep going.
phrases.odia: ନୀରବତା ମଧ୍ୟ ଶକ୍ତି ହୋଇପାରେ, ଆଗକୁ ଯାଅ।
phrases.transliteration: nirabata madhya shakti hoi pare, agaku jao

phrases.english: Good evening, I’m hungry for something nice.
phrases.odia: ଶୁଭ ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟା, ମୋତେ କିଛି ସୁଆଦିଷ୍ଟ ଖାଇବାକୁ ଅଛି।
phrases.transliteration: Shubha sandhya, mote kichhi suadista khaibaku achhi.

phrases.english: Are there any vegetarian options today?
phrases.odia: ଆଜି କିଛି ସବୁଜ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ବିକଳ୍ପ ଅଛି କି?
phrases.transliteration: Aji kichi sabuja khady bikalpa achhi ki?

phrases.english: I’d like something spicy, please.
phrases.odia: ଦୟାକରି ମୋତେ ଟିକେ ଜ୍ୱଳନ୍ତ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
phrases.transliteration: Dayakari mote tike jhulanata khady diantu.

phrases.english: Could I have it without onions?
phrases.transliteration: Piaj chadi eha miliba ki?

phrases.english: Do you serve fresh lime water?
phrases.odia: ଆପଣଙ୍କ ପାଖରେ ତାଜା ଲେମନ୍ ପାଣି ଅଛି କି?
phrases.transliteration: Apananka pakhare taja lemon pani achhi ki?

phrases.english: I’ll let this go now, please.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ଏହାକୁ ଏବେ ଛାଡ଼ି ଦେବି, ଦୟାକରି।
phrases.transliteration: Mu ēhāku ēbe chāଡ଼i debi, dayākari.

phrases.english: It’s okay, I won’t hold it.
phrases.transliteration: Thik achhi, muṁ dhari rakhibi-ni.

phrases.english: I understand, so I forgive you.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ବୁଝୁଛି, ସେଥିପାଇଁ ମୁଁ ଛାଡ଼ି ଦେଉଛି।
phrases.transliteration: Muṁ bujhuchhi, sethipāin muṁ chāଡ଼i deuchhi.

phrases.english: We can start fresh, it’s fine.
phrases.odia: ଆମେ ନୂଆ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିପାରିବା, ଠିକ୍ ଅଛି।
phrases.transliteration: Āme nūā ārambha karipāribā, thik achhi.

phrases.english: I’m choosing peace, not anger.
phrases.transliteration: Muṁ rāga nuheṁ, śānti bāchhuchhi.

phrases.english: I feel grateful for your help, today.
phrases.odia: ତୁମର ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ପାଇଁ ମୁଁ ଆଭାରୀ, ଆଜି।
phrases.transliteration: Tumara sahayata pain muṁ ābhārī, āji.

phrases.english: I feel proud of my progress.
phrases.transliteration: Muṁ mora agragati pain garbita.

phrases.english: I feel relieved that it's over.
phrases.odia: ଏହା ଶେଷ ହେଲା ବୋଲି ମୋତେ ଆଶ୍ୱସ୍ତି ଲାଗୁଛି।
phrases.transliteration: Ehā sesa hele boli mote āśwasti lāguchhi.

phrases.english: I feel lonely when you're away.
phrases.odia: ତୁମେ ଦୂରେ ଥିଲେ ମୁଁ ଏକା ଲାଗେ।
phrases.transliteration: Tume dure thile muṁ ekā lāge.

phrases.english: I feel worried about the deadline.
phrases.transliteration: Deadline nei mote chintā lāguchhi.

phrases.english: You’re stronger than you think, keep moving.
phrases.odia: ତୁମେ ଭାବୁଥିବାଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ ଶକ୍ତିଶାଳୀ, ଆଗକୁ ଯାଅ।
phrases.transliteration: tume bhabuthiba-tharu adhika shaktishali, agaku jao.

phrases.english: Take a pause, then stand tall again.
phrases.odia: ଏକ ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତ ବିରାମ ନିଅ, ତାପରେ ପୁଣି ଉଠ।
phrases.transliteration: eka muhurt ta biram niō, ta pare puni uṭha.

phrases.english: Small steps build big strength, every day.
phrases.odia: ଛୋଟ ଛୋଟ ପାଦଚାଲିଲେ ଦିନକୁ ଦିନ ଶକ୍ତି ହୁଏ।
phrases.transliteration: chhōṭ chhōṭ padachāli lē dinaku dina shakti hue.

phrases.english: Let your effort speak, don’t give up.
phrases.transliteration: tumara parishrama katha kahi ba, chhaḍa-ni.

phrases.english: Trust yourself, you’ve handled hard things.
phrases.odia: ନିଜକୁ ଭରସା କର, କଠିନ କାମ କରିଛ।
phrases.transliteration: nijaku bharasa kar, kaṭhina kam kari chha.

phrases.english: Which side do you sit on today?
phrases.transliteration: aaji tume keun paase basiba?

phrases.english: My neighbor offered me a sweet.
phrases.odia: ମୋ ପଡୋଶୀ ମୋତେ ଏକ ମିଠା ଦେଲେ।
phrases.transliteration: mo podoshi mote eka mitha dele.

phrases.english: We sprinkle water before the meal.
phrases.transliteration: bojon purbaru ame paani chhitao.

phrases.english: Please keep your shoes outside.
phrases.transliteration: dayakari juta bahare rakh.

phrases.english: The puja starts after sunrise.
phrases.transliteration: puja suryodaya pare aarambha hue.

phrases.english: My husband supports me, every day.
phrases.odia: ମୋ ସ୍ୱାମୀ ମୋତେ ସମର୍ଥନ କରନ୍ତି, ପ୍ରତିଦିନ।
phrases.transliteration: mo svaami mote samarthana karanti, pratidina.

phrases.english: Your mother calls, thank you for answering.
phrases.odia: ତୁମ ମାଆ ଡାକୁଛନ୍ତି, ଉତ୍ତର ଦେଇଥିବାରୁ ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ।
phrases.transliteration: tum maa dakuchhanti, uttara deithibaaru dhanyabaad.

phrases.english: I respect my uncle’s advice.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ମୋ ମାମାଙ୍କ ପରାମର୍ଶକୁ ସମ୍ମାନ କରେ।
phrases.transliteration: muṁ mo maamaaṅka paraamarshaku sammaan kare.

phrases.english: My aunt cooks, and it smells great.
phrases.odia: ମୋ ପିସି ରନ୍ଧେ, ଏବଂ ଗନ୍ଧ ଭଲ ଲାଗେ।
phrases.transliteration: mo pisi rande, ebam gandha bhala laage.

phrases.english: I trust my cousin, she’s honest.
phrases.transliteration: muṁ mo maamuṭi/chachaauku bishwas kare, se satyabaadi.

phrases.english: Peace grows when I slow my breath,
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ଶ୍ୱାସ ଧୀରେ କରିଲେ ସ୍ଥିରତା ବଢ଼େ,
phrases.transliteration: Muu shwas dhire karile sthirata badhe,

phrases.english: I unclench my jaw, and soften inside.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ମୋର ଜହ୍ୱା ଢିଲା କରି, ଭିତରୁ ନରମ ହୁଏ।
phrases.transliteration: Mu mo jhowa dhila k ari, bhitru narama hue.

phrases.english: I return to myself, gently, now.
phrases.transliteration: Mu bartaman, nijaku nije pheruchhi.

phrases.english: My worries fade, step by step.
phrases.odia: ମୋର ଚିନ୍ତାଗୁଡିକ ହ୍ରାସ ପାଉଛି, ଧୀରେ ଧୀରେ।
phrases.transliteration: Mora chintagudika hrasa paauchhi, dhire dhire.

phrases.english: I listen to my breath, without chasing.
phrases.transliteration: Mu shwasaku shunuchhi, dhaaunathiba bhali.
